usageNotes: Use this to retrieve the comment and any properties attached to a specific IP or CIDR entry within a named cluster-level IPSet. The IPSet must already exist and the CIDR must be a current member — use list_cluster_firewall_ipset_name to enumerate entries first. Requires Sys.Audit on '/' and supports API tokens.

examples.summary: Read a specific CIDR entry from the 'trusted-mgmt' IPSet

tips: The 'cidr' path param accepts a plain IP (e.g. 192.168.1.5), a CIDR (e.g. 10.0.0.0/8), or a defined alias — the format is IPorCIDRorAlias.
IPSet names must start with a letter and be 2–64 characters; the API will 404 if the name or CIDR does not exist.
This endpoint operates at the cluster firewall level — it has no node equivalent; node-level IPSets use a separate /nodes/{node}/firewall path.
The returned object typically includes 'cidr', 'nomatch' (boolean negation flag), and an optional 'comment' field.
